notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Pre Release - New Hardcore Mode
notes.notes:
[b]Fixed:[/b]
    - The mouse disappeared at the end of the game.
    - The game music didn't continue to next track when the game was paused.
    - There was some problems with gamepad and UI interactions
[b]Changed:[/b]
    - Now the music playlist system will always play music without stopping.
[b]Added:[/b]
    - New Hardcore Mode - you will be able to change between modes at any time and all your progress will be saved(including your checkpoint finish times)
